name: toml
input_api: toml::from_str::<toml::Table>(&str) -> Result<Table, de::Error>; Table = Map<String, Value>; Value::{String, Integer(i64), Float(f64), Boolean, Datetime(toml_datetime::Datetime { date, time, offset }), Array, Table}
scope: Generic Table/Value tree over locally decoded UTF-8 text. toml::from_str lexes and parses through toml_parser 1.1.5 (Source::lex and parse_document events, scalar and string decoding) and toml itself assembles DeTable/DeValue, enforces table and key definition rules, and deserializes into toml::Table. The harness walks Table/Value; Datetime parts are formatted per the cell protocol and offset date-times are converted to the UTC instant arithmetically. family: toml_parser (toml-rs): toml_parser 1.1.5 lexes and emits parse events; toml assembles its own DeTable/DeValue and Table/Value tree from those events. Shared with the selected toml_edit path; not an independent lexer or parser.

name: toml_edit
input_api: str::parse::<toml_edit::DocumentMut>() -> Result<DocumentMut, TomlError>; DocumentMut derefs to Table of Item::{None, Value, Table, ArrayOfTables}; Value::{String, Integer, Float, Boolean, Datetime (Formatted<toml_datetime::Datetime>), Array, InlineTable}
scope: Format-preserving document tree over locally decoded UTF-8 text. DocumentMut::from_str parses through toml_parser 1.1.5 (lexer, events, scalar and string decoding) and toml_edit itself assembles the Document/Item/Value tree with decor and spans and enforces table and key definition rules. The harness walks Item/Value through Formatted::value(), so only decoded values are observed, not preserved formatting. Datetime parts are formatted per the cell protocol and offset date-times are converted to the UTC instant arithmetically. Both valid controls match the hand-written typed trees exactly. The pinned release implements TOML 1.1.0; only the TOML 1.0.0 subset in the two controls is tested. toml_edit stores tables in IndexMaps with std RandomState hashing; without the overlay's getrandom AFL_PRELOAD shim, 1 of 5 afl-showmap runs on service-config.toml gave 1,546 instead of 1,530 tuples (checked 2026-11-17), so its overlay fixes the hash keys (afl_fixed_hashmap_keys) and then repeats are identical.
family: toml_parser (toml-rs): toml_parser 1.1.5 lexes and emits parse events; toml_edit assembles its own format-preserving Document/Item/Value tree from those events. Shared with the selected toml path; not an independent lexer or parser.

name: taplo
input_api: taplo::parser::parse(&str) -> Parse { green_node, errors }; Parse::into_dom() -> taplo::dom::Node::{Table, Array, Bool, Str, Integer (IntegerValue::{Positive(u64), Negative(i64)}), Float (f64), Date (DateTimeValue::{OffsetDateTime, LocalDateTime, Date, Time} over the time crate), Invalid}; Node::validate() reports semantic errors
scope: DOM over locally decoded UTF-8 text. taplo::parser::parse lexes with taplo's logos-derived token enum and parses into a rowan syntax tree; Parse::into_dom builds the DOM, merging header and dotted keys into tables, and Node::validate reports semantic errors (both must be empty). The harness walks Table entries, Array items and typed values; offset date-times are converted to the UTC instant with time::OffsetDateTime::to_offset. Both valid controls match the hand-written typed trees exactly. Only the TOML 1.0.0 subset in the two controls is tested. DOM tables keep an ahash HashMap index whose default per-map seed adds ASLR-dependent addresses; without a fix ten afl-showmap repeats gave 2,287 to 2,301 edges on service-config. The harness therefore installs a fixed ahash seed source through the documented ahash random_state::set_random_source before parsing (DOM output unchanged), and the overlay also fixes getrandom bytes (afl_fixed_hashmap_keys).
family: taplo (tamasfe): own logos-derived lexer, recursive-descent parser over a rowan syntax tree and DOM builder; independent of toml_parser, toml and toml_edit (no dependency on them). Its date-time tokens are decoded with the time crate.

name: antlr-rust-toml-parser
input_api: antlr_rust_toml_parser::parse(&str) -> Result<Document, Error>; Document::items() -> [Item::{Assignment, Table}]; Assignment::{key().segments(), value()} with Value::{String, Integer(i64), Float(String), Boolean, DateTime(toml_datetime::Datetime), Array, InlineTable}; TableHeader::{key(), is_array()}
scope: Flat typed items over locally decoded UTF-8 text from antlr_rust_toml_parser::parse: the crate's checked-in ANTLR-generated lexer and parser recognize the document and its decoder returns key/value assignments with typed values (integers decoded to i64, floats as the underscore-free float token, date-times as toml_datetime::Datetime) and [table]/[[array]] headers in source order. As its README documents, table nesting and duplicate-key semantics are left to the consumer, so the harness nests assignments under the most recent header; the float payload is read with str::parse::<f64> (the crate's own test shows it is directly parseable) and offset date-times are converted to the UTC instant arithmetically. Both valid controls match the hand-written typed trees exactly; only the TOML 1.0.0 subset in the two controls is tested.
family: antlr-rust-toml-parser (ophi-dev antlr-rust-runtime workspace): own ANTLR v4 TOML grammar with a checked-in generated lexer and parser and its own typed-value decoder, run on the generic antlr-rust-runtime crate; independent of toml_parser, toml, toml_edit, taplo, boml and toml-spanner. Date-time token text is decoded with toml_datetime 1.1.1 from the toml-rs project (the date-time type crate the toml family also uses); no toml-rs lexer or parser is involved.
